title: Viva Engage: enhanced Microsoft Copilot with Engage tools, work context and agents
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the automatic, licensed Engage experience, its read-only pane, and the separate Cowork plugin controls and billing. The roadmap target is correctly distinguished from the already-published documentation. Two abbreviated checklist paths should give the remaining steps already present in the controls table.
